media:group.media:title: TOUCH your Blender 👀 Blender Today LIVE #292
media:group.media:description:
Hola Community! Pablo here. Let's see what's new in Blender.
This is all possible thanks to your donations. If you like what you see, keep it going at fund.blender.org 🧡
What's New Changelog and Q&A: https://devtalk.blender.org/t/touch-your-blender-blender-today-live-292/46170?sort=old
--
BlenderToday is a live show highlighting the latest news in Blender development, the community, and Q&A. Streaming from the Blender HQ in Amsterdam since 2018, hosted by Pablo Vazquez (Senior Product Designer at Blender).
Streaming at 17:00 CEST (UTC+2) every other week. Amsterdam: 17:00, Buenos Aires: 12:00, Dubai: 19:00, London: 16:00, Los Angeles: 08:00, New York: 11:00, São Paulo: 12:00, Shanghai: 23:00, Sydney: 01:00, Tokyo: 00:00. media:group.media:title: Default Cube: the Interview
media:group.media:description:
The default cube wants to remind you that the Blender Survey ends on October 31st. Participate today: your answers will help define the future direction of Blender development!

media:group.media:description:
The recording of the Blender Education SIG Community Meeting, a gathering for pre-university, university and professional teachers.
The program:

Koning 1:45:48 Blender Badges project by Edouard Simon, Wobbe F. Koning, Raul Alfredo Gonzalez, Federico Fiore, Catina Yiu & Monique Dewanchand

media:group.media:description: Jonas Holzman showcases the progress of the Blender on Android project. Use the link in the comments to download the demo APK and try it on your device. #b3d
